2. **`server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`** — Connect (connect-go) adapter on the `ConnectServiceHandler` struct (implements `ShortcutServiceHandler`), which delegates to `APIV1Service`:

The real business logic lives in `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go`; the Connect handler in `connect_services.go` is a thin proxy that forwards each call to the corresponding `APIV1Service` method.
